learning_outcomes: Explain the role of matching strings with regular expressions in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.

content.intro: Learn Matching Strings with Regular Expressions through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding matching strings with regular expressions helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Matching Strings with Regular Expressions helps you reason about match operators. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Match operators. Then connect it to match and match?. The remaining syllabus points—Checking whether a string matches a pattern—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
